rows.note: All 79 recorded trials of the evaluated checkpoint (68% in the paper's table). Trials where a person reached in before the outcome, or whose recording stops early, are left out.

cats.title: Pushes the machine
cats.cap: The mug meets the machine's front instead of the tray, and the arm keeps pushing, sliding the machine away.

cats.title: Falls in front of the tray
cats.cap: The mug reaches the machine but slips from the gripper and lands on the table in front of it.

cats.title: Drops it in the carry
cats.cap: The mug is lifted, tilts in the fingers and falls before it reaches the machine.

cats.title: Never lifts the mug
cats.cap: The fingers close beside the handle instead of on it, and the trial is stopped.

cats.title: Knocks it over
cats.cap: The gripper catches the mug while closing and tips it onto its side.

rows.note: All 52 recorded trials of the evaluated checkpoint (76% in the paper's table). Four failed trials in which a person reached in mid-trial are left out.

cats.title: Never lifts the mug
cats.cap: The fingers close on the side of the mug or beside the handle, and it stays on the table.

cats.title: Tips it over
cats.cap: The gripper pushes the mug over while closing on it.

cats.title: Drops it
cats.cap: The mug is lifted but slips out of the fingers before the pour.

cats.title: Stops short
cats.cap: The mug is lifted and carried, but never tipped over the bowl.

rows.note: All 43 recorded trials of a later four-drill checkpoint; the 65% in the paper's table is from an earlier one whose few recordings show a person adjusting the drill. Most recordings stop before the gripper lets go, so only failures before the release are counted.

cats.title: Drops it in the carry
cats.cap: The drill is lifted and turned upright but slips out of the fingers and lands on its side.

cats.title: Knocks it over
cats.cap: The gripper tips the drill onto its side while closing on the handle.

cats.title: Never grasps it
cats.cap: The gripper closes beside the drill's nose rather than on the handle and backs away.

rows.note: 29 recorded trials of the evaluated checkpoint (85% in the paper's table, 40 trials). Recordings that run several attempts back to back with a reset in between are left out.

cats.title: Falls in the carry
cats.cap: The drill is lifted and carried, then slips out of the fingers or topples as it is set down.

cats.title: Tips over at the lift
cats.cap: The drill rotates in the fingers as it leaves the table and falls onto its side.
